Questions

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

How much does men's coaching cost at The Aligned Man Project?
The Aligned Assessment Call is $150 (and credits toward any program within 14 days). Foundation is $150/month. Alignment is $2,497 for 12 weeks. Ascension is $3,997 for 16 weeks and is the only tier that includes Phase 4 — Locked In.
What is The Aligned Method?
A four-phase transformation framework built across three pillars — Physical, Mental, and Spiritual. Phase 1 breaks the cycle, Phase 2 builds the new you, Phase 3 carries you through the transition, and Phase 4 locks the new identity in during a fourth month of consolidation.
Do I need to be in shape before I start?
No. The program meets you exactly where you are — every program starts with a full clinical-style intake so your training, nutrition, and structure are built from your real starting point, not an imaginary one.
What makes this different from other men's coaching programs?
Rob is a Registered Nurse who lived every part of this — 140 lbs lost, three hip surgeries overcome, a decade of sobriety, divorce, and rebuilding as a father. The coaching combines clinical assessment skills with lived experience across all three pillars, not just workouts.
Which program should I start with?
If you're unsure, start with the Aligned Assessment Call — 60 minutes, $150, fully credited toward any program if you enroll within 14 days. You'll leave with a written assessment of where you stand either way.
Is there a refund policy?
Alignment and Ascension are fully refundable any time before the program begins — that's your kickoff call or your first materials, whichever comes first. After that the fee is committed. If a medical event or a family emergency comes up, the program pauses for up to 60 days at no cost instead.
